Direction from Jack Heart, 2026-11-23, after `etude view experiments/ --source r2://manabot/jobs` read 1.3 GB in about 17 minutes and published no runs (307,458 keys, 108 GB under 517 names; notes in scratch/demo-notes.md). His words: "publish a reasonable prototype here that is targeted at supporting *future* experiments in a fast way that doesnt require super high storage of all the data". Asked what the local view should read, he answered: "just the most recent experiment hardcoded". Reading (mine): this PR's view follows one experiment, not a whole source. It lists and reads only that experiment's prefix in the source (never other top-level names), takes the experiment from the one file PATH names, and adds no window, filter or flag for choosing more. Keep the cached bytes to what that one experiment's charts need. Also still owed from the demo: breadcrumbs (steer fb67f5d5). A hosted server with Postgres fed by jobs pushing is a separate Task, not this PR. Then publish.
